title: This Beetle Fires Near-Boiling Spray 500 Times a Second

scenes.text: This beetle shoots boiling liquid out of its rear.
It's the bombardier beetle. Inside its body, it keeps two chemicals apart.
When attacked, they mix and heat up to nearly 100 degrees Celsius.
The spray fires in about 500 pulses every second.
And the beetle can aim the blast right at its attacker.
A beetle with a built-in boiling cannon.

description:
The bombardier beetle blasts attackers with a near-boiling chemical spray fired in about 500 pulses per second.
Two harmless chemicals mix inside its body and react violently.
Would you poke one?
first_comment: This beetle is a tiny chemical cannon. What other animal weapon blows your mind?
